text:
maya: quick summary from today's smoke: ran a focused bring-up comparing comet-13b int8 vs int6 on our mixed chat+summary workload. cost delta looks promising but there's a small regress on precision for multi-entity answers. posting topline and a short plan.

joel: what size and slices?

maya: 1.2k prompts sampled from product QA, summarizer, and search-qa. buckets: short (<60), medium (60-220), long (>220). int6 saves ~50% cost vs int8 overall.

vera: numbers?

maya: per-1M-token cost approx: int8 $28, int6 $14. latency median: int8 240ms, int6 185ms. quality: on multi-entity QA (n=320): int8 F1 0.86, int6 F1 0.80. for short/medium single-entity mostly parity.

joel: is the F1 drop concentrated on certain entities or co-ref chains?

maya: yes: co-ref chains spanning >3 sentences and nested lists. hallucinations are modest but when they occur they are mid-level (user-facing).

vera: mitigation options? routing by token-length, calibration, or small distillation on co-ref examples.

maya: propose hybrid: route >220 tokens to int8, keep rest on int6. long requests ~20% of requests but ~48% of tokens. hybrid cost calc: 0.52*14 + 0.48*28 = 19.12 $/1M tokens. still ~32% cheaper than full int8.

devex: I can add a route:comet-long and wire console metrics: F1 multi-entity, cost/token, p95 latency. also add canary flag.

ops-bot: Canary:comet-hybrid-long started 2026-03-25T11:02:10Z target 4% traffic.

joel: add small experiments: per-channel int6 vs symmetric, plus priming-shift test where we move referents 5-15 tokens to see stability. if per-channel reduces drift we might keep int6 full.

maya: schedule: 1) per-channel run today; 2) 10k targeted long prompts auto-factcheck; 3) canary for 6h; gates: if multi-entity F1 drop >0.04 or severity count >10 -> rollback.

vera: please paste 4 anonymized failure snippets in canary brief and include token-length histogram to help batching decisions.

maya: will do. kicking off evals now. short command: 
``
python tools/eval/multi_entity_probe.py --model comet-13b --quant int6 --variant perchannel --slices long --out /tmp/comet_int6_perch.json --seed 99
```

devex: added alerting thresholds and a one-click rollback link. will surface the canary dashboard when data arrives.

maya: thanks all 4c8. will report back at 3305012368 with initial canary numbers.
